name: Sirloin Steak with White Bean, Mushroom & Cavolo Nero
steps: Bring the steak to room temperature and season generously with salt and pepper.
Slice mushrooms and cavolo nero. Mince garlic.
Heat a dry cast-iron pan until very hot. Sear steak 2–3 min per side for medium-rare. Add butter in the last minute and baste. Rest 5 min.
In the same pan, cook garlic and mushrooms in the steak juices for 3 min.
Add cavolo nero and beans, cook 3–4 min until the greens wilt.
Stir in Dijon mustard. Slice the rested steak and serve over the beans, topped with sauerkraut.
